description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the CompanyStructureService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various methods such as fetching, saving, adding, deleting subunits, setting organization name, retrieving subunit trees, and obtaining the chain of subunit IDs by hierarchy.

classes.name: CompanyStructureServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the methods of the CompanyStructureService in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of CompanyStructureService, and populates test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetSubunitById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Subunit object by ID using the service.

methods.name: testSaveSubunit
methods.description: Tests saving a Subunit object via the service.

methods.name: testAddSubunit
methods.description: Tests adding a new Subunit under a parent Subunit.

methods.name: testDeleteSubunit
methods.description: Tests deleting a Subunit object via the service.

methods.name: testSetOrganizationName
methods.description: Tests setting the organization name through the service.

methods.name: testGetSubunitTreeObject
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the entire Subunit hierarchy tree.

methods.name: testGetSubunitChainById
methods.description: Tests retrieving the chain of Subunit IDs from a specific Subunit up to the root.
